about: One-line descriptions of EXISTING public functions of the shared tools files that have no docstring (card chat-T8, user 2026-10-09). Key '<module>.<function>' (module = file name without .py; a method is 'Class.method'). Writing a docstring into an existing function would shift every file:line citation below it, so its description lives here; a NEW function carries a docstring instead (docs/script-writing.md rule 9). tools/gen_capabilities.py shows a docstring first, else this entry, else '(undocumented)'; a key whose function is gone is a WARN in doc_lint L12. Each entry says what the function does and what it returns, verified by reading its code.

items.stage_prerun.sha256: SHA-256 hex digest of a file; a .py/.ps1 is hashed WITHOUT its scope header block (scope_header.canonical_bytes) so records written before the header migration still match. Returns the hex string.
items.stagesim.parse_addr: Terminal address -> {'uid': head, 'term': terminal}: a dict is copied, a '<uid>.<terminal>' / 'new:<kind><n>.<terminal>' string is split at its first '.'; anything else raises SimError.
items.stagexec.edges: Groups terminal rows by wire_uid; returns (E, dang): E = set of (source term_uid, sink term_uid) pairs of every wire, dang = term_uids on a wire that has no source or no sink.
items.addrcheck.jev_switched_on: True when the Jev address advisory is on: env ADDR_JEV is not '0' and the JSON at path (default MEASURE) has a truthy 'switched_on'; an absent or unreadable file gives False. Returns bool.
items.allterms.main: CLI: reads every terminal of the VI (read_terms with --op, default OP_ALLTERMS) and every wire uid, joins them into a wire table, flags severed wires; writes <stem>.json (meta + terminals) and <stem>_wires.json, prints the meta. Returns 0.
items.audit_cycle.say: Appends {check, ok, detail} to the module RESULT list and prints a PASS / FAIL / n-a line (ok True / False / other). Returns None.
items.audit_cycle.read: Text of file p (utf-8, errors replaced); '' when it cannot be opened. Returns str.
items.audit_cycle.main: CLI cycle audit over a window (--from/--to, else --since-hours; --cycle labels it): the A/C checks on bench build logs and archived reviews plus doc_lint, each via say(); prints AUDIT PASS or VIOLATIONS (JSON summary with --json). Returns 1 if any check failed, else 0.
items.bgrun.main: CLI runner: runs the command after -- with output appended to --log between BGRUN START/PID and END/TIMEOUT lines, reaps dead runners' logs, records stage runs, tree-kills at --max-min; --detach relaunches detached. Returns child rc, 1 if rc 0 but a RESULT line failed, 124 on timeout.
items.bgrun_reap.killed_line: The newline-terminated 'BGRUN KILLED (external) pid=<pid> marked <now> by <who>: ...' line that reap() appends to a dead runner's log. Returns str.
items.bgrun_reap.main: CLI over reap(): marks (with --dry-run only lists) dead-runner logs under --bench, excluding $BGRUN_LOG; prints MARKED / LIVE / NO-PID lines, a scanned/marked summary and a RESULT line. Returns 0.
items.card_clock.find_bind: First 'BOUND agent ... (id <cid>)' line of the guard_card log: returns (datetime of its stamp, 1-based line number), or (None, None) when the log or the line is absent.
items.card_clock.clock: Measures a result file's minutes (its mtime minus the card's first bind line) against the task card's budget.minutes and the claimed cost.minutes. Returns (CLOCK line, verdict OK / CLOCK-MISMATCH / CLOCK-UNMEASURED, rc 0 / 1 / 2).
items.card_clock.main: CLI: clock() on one result_<id>.json (--log, --cards); prints the CLOCK line and a RESULT line (SKIP when unmeasured, FAIL on a mismatch). Returns clock's rc 0 / 1 / 2.
items.census_predict.md5_of: MD5 hex digest of the file at p (read whole, binary). Returns str.
items.census_predict.predict: Resolves each plan action to a sampled class-count delta, sums them, and compares per class with the prediction file's census block. Returns {rows, classes (derived/declared/verdict), derived, declared, unpredicted row numbers, overall PASS/FAIL/UNPREDICTED/UNDECLARED}.
items.census_predict.result_line: The 'RESULT {...}' result-line/1 string of a predict() report: FAIL on a failing class, SKIP for UNPREDICTED / UNDECLARED, else PASS, with per-class pass/fail counts and the given artefacts. Returns str.
items.census_predict.main: CLI: 'record <op> <variant> --delta .. --cites ..' stores a measured sample (record_sample); otherwise '<plan.json> <pred.json> [--samples] [--json]' prints ROW / CLASS / VERDICT lines and a RESULT line. Returns 0 PASS or recorded, 1 FAIL, 2 UNPREDICTED, 3 UNDECLARED, 4 error.
items.cycle_runner.spawn_env: Copy of os.environ for a spawned session: drops the inherited role variables (CYCLE_ROLE, ASSIGN_STATE, ASSIGN_RESULT, PURPOSE_PHASE, HANDBACK_RECORD), adds SPAWN_ENV_EXTRA, then `extra`. Returns dict.
items.cycle_runner.read: Text of file p (utf-8, errors replaced); '' when it cannot be opened. Returns str.
items.cycle_runner.next_section: Body of the '## NEXT' section of STATUS text (up to the next '## ' heading), stripped; '' when there is none. Returns str.
items.cycle_runner.next_last_line: Last non-blank line of the NEXT section, cut to 160 chars; '(no NEXT section)' when the section is empty or absent. Returns str.
items.cycle_runner.log_line: Appends text plus a newline to the log at path (creating its folder; an OSError is ignored) and prints the text. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.last_cycle_number: Highest N among the 'CYCLE N |' lines of the runner log; 0 when there are none. Returns int.
items.cycle_runner.goalmap_done: Set of milestone ids whose status is 'done' in the goal-map JSON at path; empty set when the file is absent or unreadable. Returns set.
items.cycle_runner.judge_state_load: Reads <bench>/judge_ladder.json. Returns (level clamped to 0..JUDGE_TOP, reason); (0, 'start') when the file is absent or malformed.
items.cycle_runner.judge_state_save: Writes {level, reason (300 chars), after_cycle n, at now} to <bench>/judge_ladder.json; any failure is swallowed. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat: Runner heartbeat state (current cycle, phase, cycles done, summed cost); emit() writes the HEARTBEAT line to the runner log, rewrites heartbeat_latest.md and raises a toast.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.begin: Marks cycle n as running and stamps its start time. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.cycle_end: Counts one finished cycle, adds its cost (a '$x' string; an unparseable one is ignored), sets the phase to 'ended HH:MM (exit rc, cost)' and emits a cycle-end heartbeat. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.emit: Writes one 'HEARTBEAT | ...' line (cycle, last result card, hook states, open decisions, deliverables, next act) to the runner log, rewrites heartbeat_latest.md, raises a toast; an error becomes a HEARTBEAT-ERROR line. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.Heartbeat.final: Emits the 'final' heartbeat once; later calls do nothing. Returns None.
items.cycle_runner.newest_assign_result: Path of the most recently modified assign_result_*.json in cards_dir, or None when there is none.
items.cycle_runner.purpose_from_next: The assignment card's purpose dict from a next.json card: act and pass items (each cut to 200 chars), plan {path, md5} or None, advances, unblocks, task_kind, note. Returns dict.
items.cycle_runner.write_assign_card: Builds and validates an assign/1 card (cycle, round, purpose, next_md5, caps from cfg, state / result / handback paths, ASSIGN_AGENTS) and writes cards_dir/assign_<n>_<k>.json. Returns (path, None), or (None, why) when it does not validate.
items.cycle_runner.write_handback: Writes cards_dir/handback_<n>_<k>.json (handback/1: trigger, detail, the assignment state's card rows, result path, next_md5, cost, minutes); a record that fails validation is replaced by a minimal one carrying the reason. Returns the path.
items.cycle_runner.main: CLI entry of the cycle runner: parses the run options (caps, budget, models, flow, self-test switches), reads the prompt file, creates a Heartbeat and runs _loop; the final heartbeat is always emitted. Returns _loop's exit code, 4 when the prompt is missing.
items.doc_lint.say: Appends (level, check, detail) to the module RESULT list. Returns None.
items.doc_lint.read: Text of file p (utf-8, errors replaced); '' when it cannot be opened. Returns str.
items.doc_lint.rel: Path p relative to the project root, with forward slashes. Returns str.
items.doc_lint.check_frontmatter: L1: every active doc and archive/peer/*.md has frontmatter with type, status and date; records PASS, or a WARN with the missing / incomplete counts, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_citations: L2 / L2b / L2c: every project path cited in an active doc exists (FAIL when dangling; a plan doc's missing file is a WARN) and every cited :line is inside the file (WARN). Records via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_status_length: L3: WARN when STATUS.md has more than STATUS_MAX_LINES lines, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_one_current_plan: L4: FAIL when current_plans() finds more than one current plan, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_supersedes: L5: WARN when an active doc's 'supersedes:' names a doc still marked status: current, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_marked_decisions: L7: WARN listing active-doc lines that use a decision / measurement word without a DECIDED: / MEASURED: / DECISION: / ANSWERED: / FAILED: mark, else PASS, via say(). Returns None.
items.doc_lint.check_decision_headers: L8: '## <slug> - <date>' headers of docs/violation-decisions.md (or path) without a parseable HH:MM: FAIL if dated >= L8_FAIL_FROM, WARN if older with an unparseable time; via say(). Returns (fails, warns) lists of file:line.
items.doc_lint.check_user_rules_lines: L9: WARN listing Pre-decided items numbered >= L9_FROM_ITEM without a 'USER-RULES:' line in the given paths (default all active docs), else PASS. Returns the list of 'path:line (item n)'.
items.doc_lint.is_frozen: True when the doc at p has frontmatter status: frozen. Returns bool.
items.doc_lint.run: Clears RESULT and runs every lint check in order, L1 to L12 (L6 replaced by a PASS note when skip_dispositions). Returns a copy of the (level, check, detail) list.
items.doc_lint.main: CLI: run() (--skip-dispositions; --quiet prints FAILs only), prints each result and a 'DOC-LINT PASS/FAIL: n fail, n warn, n pass' line. Returns 1 when any check FAILed, else 0.
items.elrule.unwired_inputs: {owner_uid: [terminal names]} of every non-source terminal in state['terminals'] that has no wire and is not a ControlTerminal. Returns a defaultdict(list).
items.errorlist_check.md5: MD5 hex digest of file p. Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.not_ready: True when the exception's repr carries a COM-not-ready marker ('-2147221231' or 'ClassFactory'). Returns bool.
items.errorlist_check.windows_named: [(hwnd, title)] of the LabVIEW process's top-level windows whose title contains sub, case-insensitive. Returns list.
items.errorlist_check.open_diagram: Makes sure '<scratch name> Block Diagram' is open: otherwise fronts the VI window and sends Ctrl+E (before/after shots and a confirm act in R['gui_acts_outer']), waiting up to 15 s. Returns True when the diagram window exists.
items.errorlist_check.make_on_item: Builds the per-item callback for lv_errorlist.read: double-clicks the Error List row, shoots the block diagram before/after and stores show_error (fronted, changed, screenshot) on the item; raises RuntimeError if the Error List closed. Returns the callback.
items.errorlist_check.norm: Lower-cases s and drops every character outside a-z0-9 (None gives ''). Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.ocr_fold: Applies the OCR aliases in order ('vl' -> 'vi', then 'v' -> 'y') to a normalised key. Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.norm_ocr: ocr_fold(norm(s)): the alias-folded normal form used for OCR-tolerant matching. Returns str.
items.errorlist_check.derive_expected: Error List licence rules from a stageplan's open_rows: per SubVI row a '<term> is not wired' rule, per other node one 'contains unwired or bad terminal' rule, plus one uncapped wire-class rule if any open row exists. Returns the rule list.
items.errorlist_check.main: CLI: copies the bed VI (--vi or STATUS's bed) to a scratch, opens it, reads its Error List (count-only or full with a double-click per item), compares with the expected file or plan licences, deletes the scratch, writes errorlist_<bed>_<stamp>.json and a RESULT line. Returns 0 OK, 1 MISMATCH, 2 FAIL.
items.fn_records.rel: Path p relative to the project root with forward slashes; on a ValueError (another drive) p itself with forward slashes. Returns str.
items.fn_records.reg_path: Registry file of function fn: <reg_dir or tools/bench/fn_records>/<fn with ':' replaced by '_'>.json. Returns the path (str).
items.fn_records.load: The fnrec record of function fn read from its registry file, or None when the file does not exist. Returns dict or None.
items.fn_records.write_record: Writes rec (indent 1, UTF-8, trailing newline) to the registry file of rec['function'], creating the registry folder. Returns the path written.
items.fn_records.predicted: The 'predicted' block of a test plan from fncontract.TABLE: {postcondition: 'op value'} when the row has 'post', else a {'note': ...} saying no TABLE row / no postcondition. Returns dict.
items.fn_records.make_plan: Builds the fnrec/1 test-plan record of fn: source file/defs/line/md5 (locate), plan (card, scratch bed, inputs from PLAN_INPUTS or a default, predicted, outcome contract, pass_if), empty records, legacy scratch_verify evidence. Returns dict.
items.fn_records.routes_of_plan: Sorted set of route names (the part before ':') of a stageplan JSON's finalized.route_check rows; the actions' op kinds when it is not finalized; [] when unreadable. Returns list.
items.fn_records.load_config: The FN-gate config: JSON at path (default tools/bench/fn_records/gate_config.json), or a copy of DEFAULT_CONFIG when that file is absent. Returns dict.
items.fn_records.main: CLI: --write-config, --write-plans, --status [fn ...], --advise <unit> (launch_gate; returns 2 if refused), --add-record FN STATUS --log ... --card ...; prints what it did. Returns 0, or 2 on a refused --advise.
items.fncontract.outcome: Builds one standard outcome {outcome, fn, reason (300 chars), measured, expected}; raises ValueError when status is not in OUTCOMES. Returns dict.
items.fncontract.mark: Current sequence number of the call-outcome HISTORY (pass it to since()). Returns int.
items.fncontract.since: Outcomes recorded in HISTORY after sequence mark m, oldest first. Returns list of outcome dicts.
items.gate_fp.is_checker_gate: True when the gate name is a checker gate: 'guard_<x>' or 'checker:<stage_prerun|stagekit|stagesim|stop_record|protocol|launchunit|doc_lint>[:label]', case-insensitive. Returns bool.
items.gate_fp.read_queue: Every JSON row of the false-positive queue (path, default tools/bench/gate_fp_queue.jsonl or $GATE_FP_QUEUE); blank or unparsable lines skipped, [] when unreadable. Returns list of dicts.
items.gate_fp.main: CLI subcommands: log (log_fp), drain, note, close, list [--open], due; prints LOGGED / DEDUPED / DRAINED / NOTED / CLOSED / REFUSED or the list. Returns 0, 2 on a refusal or no command, 1 when 'due' finds the queue due.
items.gateclass.is_tunnel_class: True when cls is one of TUNNEL_OBJECT_CLASSES (LoopTunnel, Tunnel, SelectorTunnel, FlatSequence inner/outer) or any 'FlatSequence...Tunnel' name. Returns bool.
items.gateclass.is_semantic: True unless cls is in NON_SEMANTIC_CLASSES (Terminal, InnerTerminal, OuterTerminal, ParameterTerminal, Invoke, LooseEnds, TunnelFace): fail-closed. Returns bool.
items.gateclass.gate_kind: (kind, why) of a gate label: the first GATE_TABLE regex matching the label (name / census / rows / arith / fixture); ('stop', fail-closed note) when none matches. Returns tuple.
items.gscript.lv: The module's LabVIEW.Application COM object, dispatched on first use and cached; _check_poison runs first (raises COMPoisoned while an abandoned COM call is still outstanding). Returns the COM object.
items.gscript.op_hygiene_record_path: Path of an op VI's hygiene record: tools/bench/op_hygiene/<op file name without extension>.json. Returns str.
items.gscript.shutil_copy: Copies file src to dst (shutil.copyfile, data only) then sleeps 0.2 s. Returns None.
items.gscript.count: Number of objects of class cls on target's diagram, read by one OP_REPORT run ('# of Refs'); raises RuntimeError on an op error. Returns int.
items.gscript.uids: Set of uids of every object of class cls on target, from one report_all() op run. Returns set of int.
items.gscript.for_loop: Creates a For Loop on target at location via OP_FORLOOP with tunnels from the named controls, their indexing flags and the static parallel-instance count; ensure_loaded first, RuntimeError on an op error. Returns the op run time (_run).
items.gscript.exec_state: target's VI ExecState read through a short-lived counted vi_ref (0 = broken). Returns int.
items.gscript.main: CLI: 'report <vi> <class>' prints one line per object (index, class, uid, pos, owner); 'kernel <vi>' runs build_kernel; 'save <vi>' saves and prints the size. Returns 0, 2 on usage or an unknown command.
items.gscript.print_net_map: Prints net_map() output: per node '[n] style | label', then per terminal the other node.terminals on its wire, or UNWIRED / '(wire w, no other terminal in this diagram)'. Returns None.
items.hash_probe.probe: One 'HASH <path> | exists=1 | size=n | md5=.. | sha256=..' line for a file read in 1 MiB chunks; 'exists=0' with '-' fields when it is not a file. Returns str.
items.hash_probe.main: CLI: prints probe() for each path on argv. Returns 0, 2 (with a usage line) when no path is given.
items.jev.get_key: The TypeSafe API key from env TYPESAFE_API_KEY, else from the user Environment registry key (HKCU); None when neither has it. Returns str or None.
items.jev.normalise: Text with volatile parts masked: 32-hex md5 -> '<md5>', timestamps -> '<ts>', '#n' and numbers of 3+ digits -> '#', the project root path -> '<root>'. Returns str.
items.jev_candidates.node_labels_default: {uid: label} from tools/bench/main_vi_node_labels.json (every diagram's rows); {} when the file is absent. Returns dict.
items.jev_candidates.sink_state: State of a sink terminal row r in graph G: 'free' (wire_uid 0), 'half-wire' (wire in G['halfwire_nosrc']), else 'occupied'. Returns str.
items.jev_candidates.term_row: Candidate dict of terminal row key in G: key, uid, term, term_uid, term_class, owner_class, diagram, wire_uid, subvi; a tunnel owner also gets outer_wire (its OuterTerminal's wire uid). Returns dict.
items.jev_chain.reaches: True when node b is among the nodes reachable from node a (vigraph.reach4). Returns bool.
items.jev_chain.true_next: True when x is a direct subVI successor of y and x is z or reaches z. Returns bool.
items.jev_chain.subvi_line: One text line for subVI node u: '#u name; pane: label (direction), ...' (first 16 connector-pane rows from the wiki, or '(not in the wiki)') plus the wiki summary. Returns str.
items.jev_chain.ask_link: Asks Jev (ask_n, CHAIN_Q, purpose step5-chain) whether candidate x is the next link from y toward z, with subvi_line texts as state. Returns ask_n's (mean p, spread, err).
items.jev_chain.scope_counts: {subVI name: number of call nodes} over the subVI nodes in scope below diagram root. Returns dict.
items.jev_contradict.main: CLI: parses a plan's numbered items, builds token-sharing pairs (cap --pairs, max 600), asks Jev per pair (--samples), prints the top pairs and those at p >= --threshold, writes the readings JSON (--out). Returns 0.
items.jev_device_value.corpus: Failure corpus: retrospective VIOLATION lines (with loss_min/usd) and FINDINGS paragraphs from archive/peer, plus first failing lines of failed bench bgrun logs, jev-normalised and deduplicated, optional since date. Returns list of item dicts.
items.jev_device_value.classify: Asks Jev (default ask_n, 4 threads) for each item whether the device prevented / reduced / is unrelated to it. Returns the items with answer (winning class or 'unknown'), p and spread added.
items.jev_device_value.totals: Per-class counts, loss_min/loss_usd sums for prevented plus half of reduced (expected), the date span in days and expected loss minutes per day. Returns dict.
items.jev_device_value.main: CLI: --device text [--since/--after date, --slug, --dry, --reprint]: builds the corpus, classifies it (or reloads the saved JSON), prints one row per item and TOTALS, writes device_value_<slug>.json, compares with a prior run when --after. Returns 0.
items.jev_gaterow.main: CLI: '<bgrun log> [--run i] [--json out]': one Jev class per FAIL row of that run, printed as and appended to jev_gate.log as JEV-GATEROW lines; optional JSON of the verdicts. Returns 0, 2 on usage or no FAIL row.
items.jev_pairs.thresholds: The Jev menu thresholds from tools/bench/jev_menu_thresholds.json; when unreadable, defaults (pair/op/chain act 0.90, risk 0.10, none acting). Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.pair_state: The PAIR question state of candidate c: {intent, candidate (source -> sink text with sink state, scope, borders), src_wiki, dst_wiki (wiki_line)}. Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.ask_pair: Asks Jev (ask_n, PAIR_Q, purpose step5-pair) whether candidate c is the pair the intent line asks for. Returns (mean p, spread, err).
items.jev_pairs.op_question: The Jev 'choice' question over writer ops: fixed instructions plus criteria = OP_MENU descriptions of the given option names. Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.op_state: The OP question state of candidate c: {'row': 'SOURCE #uid ... -> SINK #uid ...; scope s'}. Returns dict.
items.jev_pairs.ask_op: Asks Jev to choose the writer op for candidate c among op_options(c). Returns (best op or None, probabilities or None, options, err).
items.jev_pairs.ask_risk: Asks Jev (RISK_Q, purpose step5-risk) whether the change line with its code-computed evidence changes the original's computation. Returns (mean p, spread, err).
items.jev_pairs.write_record: Writes tools/bench/decision_<stage>.json: bed md5, intents, candidate pairs (row keys and facts), decisions, summed jev_calls, estimated cost and seconds since t0, thresholds, plus extra. Returns (path, record).
items.jev_preflight.main: CLI: '<file>': classify() it, prints each finding and one 'JEV-PREFLIGHT | <file> | class p=.. | finding ids' line (or '(no reading: err)'). Returns 0, 2 with a usage line when no argument is given.
items.jev_rowcheck.main: CLI: '[rows json] [--limit n]' (default SOURCES): check_row on each planned row against the terminal tables, prints 'JEV-ROW | i | verdict p=..' lines and an ok/suspect/unknown TOTAL line. Returns 0, 2 when the file is unreadable or has no rows list.
items.lint.self_test: Offline self-test: classify() on 8 canned paths and tabulate()/table_text()/load_shared() on canned ruff JSON; prints each failure. Returns (ok, fail) counts.
items.lint.main: CLI: --self-test runs self_test; otherwise runs ruff over tools/, prints the rule x class table, with --files <class> the per-file findings (--codes filters), and a RESULT line. Returns 0, 1 when the self-test fails.
